proposed_definition: The necessity condition for non-null distinction organization. Formally expressed as A(chi_D) => (E(chi_D) != 0), where chi_D is a distinction array.
process_rewrite: Affect and distinction organization are inseparable process-aspects. Affect is the necessity-aspect; chi_D is the organized-distinction aspect.
